title: Message or Meeting?
subtitle: 考点：沟通方式 / text message / in person
passage: Today, people can talk in many ways. Text messages are quick and easy. You can send one in seconds, and you can answer when you are free. Many teenagers use text messages to chat with friends every day.

However, text messages have problems. Sometimes it is hard to understand the real meaning because you cannot see the speaker's face or hear the voice. A joke may sound unkind, and a short reply may seem impolite. Misunderstandings can happen easily.

That is why face-to-face talk is still important. When you meet someone in person, you can see their expression and hear their tone. You can also ask questions right away. For serious or personal topics, it is better to talk in person or on the phone. Whichever way you choose, remember to show interest in the other person and to listen carefully.
vocab: text message 短信 · in person 当面 · expression 表情 · misunderstanding 误解 · personal 个人的 · carefully 仔细地 · right away 马上
